# sapintegrationsuite_partner_string_parameter (Data Source)

Reads an existing Partner Directory string parameter by its (partner_id, parameter_id) key, without managing it as a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_partner_string_parameter" "receiver_address" {
  partner_id   = "PartnerZ"
  parameter_id = "ReceiverAddress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parameter_id` (String) The string parameter's technical ID.
- `partner_id` (String) The Partner ID (Pid) this parameter is scoped to.

### Optional

- `runtime_location_id` (String) NOT SUPPORTED YET. Edge Integration Cell targeting has not passed its acceptance test on a tenant with an Edge Integration Cell; leave this unset until it has. If set, requests go to /location/<id>/api/v1 on the same tenant host, the service root SAP Help documents for Edge Integration Cells, and the value is the runtime location ID SAP shows in the monitoring URL after selecting the Edge Integration Cell as runtime ({"edge":{"runtimeLocationId":"myedge"}}). Use it only at your own risk.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form "<partner_id>/<parameter_id>".
- `value` (String) The parameter's text value.
